narrative: The bill, on the bookwheel. A black-letter bill, title only, no author's name, no sum. He reads this one before the day's list. The bill, on the bookwheel. The lower half is blank of any price.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the title first, and left the post.

entities.name: The Venetian Comedy
entities.context: Shown on bill in The Venetian Comedy
